title: Unique Charred Saudi Arabian Herring Skewers
description: A charred, flaky, show-off Saudi-Arabian dish featuring herring, perfect for a special occasion, this vegetarian-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the garlic and ginger until well combined and slightly smooth.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the mortar and pestle and pound until well combined.
Add the lemon juice and olive oil to the mortar and pestle and mix until smooth.
Thread a herring fillet onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each fillet.
Brush the herring fillets with the garlic-ginger mixture, making sure they are well coated.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until the herring is charred and flaky.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
